resources.string:
To show calls and answer or end them, AirBridge needs the Phone permission.

Contacts: your computer shows the caller's name and photo, as your phone does. Optional.

Nearby devices: your computer rings only when you're at it or your phone is close by, and keeps quiet otherwise. Optional.

Call logs: lets AirBridge see the number of the call that is ringing, so your computer shows who's calling right away. Your call history is never read. Optional.

Call details are sent only to your own paired devices, encrypted.
Show who\'s calling from the first ring
Your phone gives AirBridge the caller\'s number only with the Call logs permission. It\'s used just for the call that\'s ringing; your call history is never read.
